```{r visibility-tests, results='hide'}
  obs_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(observers)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  obs_fold <- as.integer(fold_maps[[main_seed]][as.character(block_of_points(observers))])
  dem_vis <- feature_windows$rio_frio$dem
  vis_acc <- viewshed_accumulate(dem_vis, obs_xy, fold_ids = obs_fold)
  feature_at_cells <- function(mat, nm) extract_first(window_mean_feature(matrix_to_raster(mat, dem_vis, paste0(nm, "_raw")), nm), train_pts)
  training_df$visibility_2km <- feature_at_cells(vis_acc$total_vis, "visibility_2km")
  training_df$density_2km <- feature_at_cells(vis_acc$total_den, "density_2km")
  vis_fold_values <- lapply(seq_len(spatial_cv_k), function(f) feature_at_cells(vis_acc$total_vis - vis_acc$fold_vis[[f]], "visibility_2km"))
  dens_fold_values <- lapply(seq_len(spatial_cv_k), function(f) feature_at_cells(vis_acc$total_den - vis_acc$fold_den[[f]], "density_2km"))
  names(vis_fold_values) <- as.character(seq_len(spatial_cv_k))
  names(dens_fold_values) <- as.character(seq_len(spatial_cv_k))

  visexp_rasters <- lapply(names(feature_windows), function(k) {
    dem_w <- feature_windows[[k]]$dem
    st <- lattice_stations(dem_w, visexp_spacing_m)
    acc <- viewshed_accumulate(dem_w, st)
    expo <- acc$total_vis / pmax(acc$total_den, 1)
    expo[acc$total_den == 0] <- NA_real_
    list(raster = window_mean_feature(matrix_to_raster(expo, dem_w, "visual_exposure_raw"), "visual_exposure_2km"),
         stations = acc$n_used)
  })
  names(visexp_rasters) <- names(feature_windows)
  training_df$visual_exposure_2km <- extract_first(visexp_rasters$rio_frio$raster, train_pts)
  bg_train_df$visual_exposure_2km <- extract_first(visexp_rasters$rio_frio$raster, bg_train_pts)
  for (s in names(ext_data)) {
    ext_data[[s]]$terr_df$visual_exposure_2km <- extract_first(visexp_rasters[[s]]$raster, ext_data[[s]]$terr_pts)
    for (r in names(ext_data[[s]]$local)) {
      ext_data[[s]]$local[[r]]$df$visual_exposure_2km <- extract_first(visexp_rasters[[s]]$raster, ext_data[[s]]$local[[r]]$pts)
    }
  }
  held_out_value <- function(by_fold) {
    v <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(training_df))
    for (f in seq_len(spatial_cv_k)) v[fold_main == f] <- by_fold[[as.character(f)]][fold_main == f]
    v
  }
  vis_held <- held_out_value(vis_fold_values)
  dens_held <- held_out_value(dens_fold_values)
  cls <- ifelse(training_df$presence == 1, "Terraces", "Survey negatives")
  vis_distribution <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    data.frame(variable = "Visible structures", version = "All observers", class = cls, value = training_df$visibility_2km),
    data.frame(variable = "Visible structures", version = "Held out observers removed", class = cls, value = vis_held),
    data.frame(variable = "Structures within 2 km", version = "All observers", class = cls, value = training_df$density_2km),
    data.frame(variable = "Structures within 2 km", version = "Held out observers removed", class = cls, value = dens_held)
  )
  visibility_info <- tibble::tibble(
    item = c("Observer source", "Observers used", "Radius (m)", "Observer and target height (m)",
             "Correlation of held out visibility and density", "Visual exposure stations Río Frío", "Visual exposure stations Buritaca 200"),
    value = c(observer_source, vis_acc$n_used, vis_radius_m, paste(vis_observer_height_m, vis_target_height_m, sep = " and "),
              sprintf("%.3f", stats::cor(vis_held, dens_held, use = "complete.obs")), visexp_rasters$rio_frio$stations,
              visexp_rasters$buritaca_200$stations)
  )
}
```

```{r forward-selection, results='hide'}
family_names <- c(F1 = "Local morphology", F12 = "Local morphology and hillslope hydrology", F123 = "All clean families")
run_nested_selection <- function(df, fold_vec, seed = 7L) {
  s1 <- spatial_forward_selection(df, family_vif$F1, fold_vec, seed = seed)
  p1 <- spatial_backward_prune(df, s1$selected, fold_vec, seed = seed)
  s12 <- spatial_forward_selection(df, setdiff(family_vif$F12, family_vif$F1), fold_vec, start = p1$kept, seed = seed)
  p12 <- spatial_backward_prune(df, s12$selected, fold_vec, protected = p1$kept, seed = seed)
  s123 <- spatial_forward_selection(df, setdiff(family_vif$F123, family_vif$F12), fold_vec, start = p12$kept, seed = seed)
  p123 <- spatial_backward_prune(df, s123$selected, fold_vec, protected = p12$kept, seed = seed)
  pack <- function(sel, pr, start) list(path = sel$path, chosen_step = sel$chosen_step, pruned = pr$removed, selected = pr$kept,
                                        final_auc = pr$final_auc, tolerance = pr$tolerance, start = start)
  list(F1 = pack(s1, p1, character(0)), F12 = pack(s12, p12, p1$kept), F123 = pack(s123, p123, p12$kept))
}
selection_runs <- run_nested_selection(training_df, fold_main)
predictors_f1 <- selection_runs$F1$selected
predictors_f12 <- selection_runs$F12$selected
predictors_f123 <- selection_runs$F123$selected
assert_that(all(predictors_f1 %in% predictors_f12) && all(predictors_f12 %in% predictors_f123), "The selected family sets are not nested.")
predictors_f123_elev <- unique(c(predictors_f123, "elevation"))
predictors_f123_lc <- character(0)
if (isTRUE(landcover_usable)) {
  predictors_f123_lc <- vif_screen(training_df, c(predictors_f123, intersect(lc_feature_names, names(training_df))), fixed = predictors_f123)
}
ale_spec_main <- make_ale_spec(training_df, predictors_f123, seed = 21L)
selection_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(selection_runs), function(k) {
  sr <- selection_runs[[k]]
  tibble::tibble(family_set = unname(family_names[k]), candidates = length(family_pools[[k]]), after_vif = length(family_vif[[k]]),
                 inherited_predictors = length(sr$start), added_by_forward_selection = sr$chosen_step,
                 removed_by_pruning = if (nrow(sr$pruned)) nrow(sr$pruned) else 0L, pruning_tolerance = sr$tolerance,
                 final_predictors = length(sr$selected), final_fold_auc = sr$final_auc,
                 added_predictors = if (length(setdiff(sr$selected, sr$start))) paste(var_label(setdiff(sr$selected, sr$start)), collapse = "; ") else "none")
}))
add_provenance("Selected predictors, local morphology", paste(predictors_f1, collapse = ", "))
add_provenance("Selected predictors, local morphology and hillslope hydrology", paste(predictors_f12, collapse = ", "))
add_provenance("Selected predictors, all clean families", paste(predictors_f123, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r design-calibration, results='hide'}
set.seed(cv_seeds[1] + 7L)
n_pb <- round(pb_background_ratio * sum(training_df$presence == 1))
pb_pts <- sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_sample(train_union, size = n_pb, type = "random"))

pb_df <- data.frame(presence = 0L, pb_vals)
pb_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(pb_pts)
pb_df$x <- pb_xy[, 1]
pb_df$y <- pb_xy[, 2]
pb_df$block_id <- block_of_points(pb_pts)
pb_df$cv_fold <- as.integer(fold_maps[[main_seed]][as.character(pb_df$block_id)])
pb_needed <- unique(c(jaa_predictors, predictors_f123))
pb_df <- pb_df[stats::complete.cases(pb_df[, pb_needed, drop = FALSE]) & !is.na(pb_df$cv_fold), , drop = FALSE]

run_pb_cv <- function(predictors, algorithm, label) {
  pred <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(training_df))
  comp_rows <- list()
  for (f in sort(unique(fold_main))) {
    te_idx <- which(fold_main == f)
    tr_idx <- buffered_train_idx(training_df, fold_main, f)
    pres_tr <- training_df[tr_idx[training_df$presence[tr_idx] == 1], c("presence", predictors), drop = FALSE]
    bg_cand <- which(pb_df$cv_fold != f)
    if (cv_buffer_m > 0 && length(bg_cand)) {
      dbg <- FNN::get.knnx(as.matrix(training_df[te_idx, c("x", "y")]), as.matrix(pb_df[bg_cand, c("x", "y")]), k = 1)$nn.dist[, 1]
      bg_cand <- bg_cand[dbg > cv_buffer_m]
    }
    bg_tr <- pb_df[bg_cand, c("presence", predictors), drop = FALSE]
    tr <- rbind(pres_tr, bg_tr)
    te <- training_df[te_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    if (algorithm == "glm") {
      pred[te_idx] <- fit_glm_predict(tr, te, predictors)
    } else {
      mdl <- fit_components(tr, predictors, seed = 500L + as.integer(f))
      comp_rows[[length(comp_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(row_id = te$row_id, fold = f, obs = te$presence, predict_components(mdl, te))
    }
  }
  if (algorithm == "glm") {
    cv <- data.frame(row_id = training_df$row_id, fold = fold_main, obs = training_df$presence, ens = pred)
    return(list(label = label, cv = cv, metrics = calc_binary_metrics(cv$obs, cv$ens), predictors = predictors))
  }
  ens <- weighted_ensemble(dplyr::bind_rows(comp_rows))
  list(label = label, cv = ens$cv, metrics = calc_binary_metrics(ens$cv$obs, ens$cv$ens), predictors = predictors)
}

repeat_delta <- function(a, b) {
  vals <- vapply(names(fold_vectors), function(s) {
    ka <- paste(s, a, sep = "|")
    kb <- paste(s, b, sep = "|")
    if (!all(c(ka, kb) %in% names(repeat_runs))) return(NA_real_)
    x <- merge(repeat_runs[[ka]]$cv[, c("row_id", "obs", "ens")], repeat_runs[[kb]]$cv[, c("row_id", "ens")],
               by = "row_id", suffixes = c("_a", "_b"))
    fast_auc(x$obs, x$ens_b) - fast_auc(x$obs, x$ens_a)
  }, numeric(1))
  vals[is.finite(vals)]
}

contrast_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(contrast_specs), function(i) {
  z <- contrast_specs[[i]]
  d <- delta_block_bootstrap(all_res[[z$a]], all_res[[z$b]], seed = 1000L + i)
  rd <- repeat_delta(z$a, z$b)
  outcome <- if (identical(z$type, "Leakage")) {
    "Leakage, diagnostic only"
  } else if (d$ci_low > 0) {
    "Improves"
  } else if (d$ci_high < 0) {
    "Degrades"
  } else {
    "No detectable difference"
  }
  data.frame(contrast = z$label, type = z$type, reference = z$a, model = z$b, d,
             partitions = max(1L, length(rd)), partition_mean = if (length(rd)) mean(rd) else d$delta_auc,
             partition_sd = if (length(rd) > 1) stats::sd(rd) else NA_real_, outcome = outcome)
}))

}))
```

```{r nested-cv, results='hide'}
nested_table <- tibble::tibble(family_set = character(0), algorithm = character(0), AUC = numeric(0), AUC_low = numeric(0), AUC_high = numeric(0))
nested_freq <- tibble::tibble(family_set = character(0), predictor = character(0), outer_folds_selected = integer(0))
if (isTRUE(run_nested_cv)) {
  outer_rows <- list()
  sel_rows <- list()
  for (f in sort(unique(fold_main))) {
    tr_idx <- buffered_train_idx(training_df, fold_main, f)
    te_idx <- which(fold_main == f)
    dtr <- training_df[tr_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    inner_map <- assign_block_folds(dtr$block_id, dtr$presence, spatial_cv_k, cv_seeds[1] + as.integer(f))
    inner <- as.integer(inner_map[as.character(dtr$block_id)])
    nsel <- run_nested_selection(dtr, inner, seed = 7L)
    for (k in names(nsel)) {
      vars <- nsel[[k]]$selected
      mdl <- fit_components(dtr, vars, seed = 900L + as.integer(f))
      comp <- predict_components(mdl, training_df[te_idx, , drop = FALSE])
      outer_rows[[length(outer_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(family_set = k, algorithm = "Ensemble", fold = f, row_id = training_df$row_id[te_idx],
                                                          obs = training_df$presence[te_idx], ens = combine_components(comp, c(rf = 1, xgb = 1, gbm = 1)))
      outer_rows[[length(outer_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(family_set = k, algorithm = "GLM", fold = f, row_id = training_df$row_id[te_idx],
                                                          obs = training_df$presence[te_idx],
                                                          ens = fit_glm_predict(dtr, training_df[te_idx, , drop = FALSE], vars))
      sel_rows[[length(sel_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(family_set = k, fold = f, predictor = vars)
    }
  }
  nest_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(outer_rows)
  nested_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(split(nest_df, list(nest_df$family_set, nest_df$algorithm), drop = TRUE), function(d) {
    ci <- block_bootstrap_auc(d[, c("row_id", "obs", "ens")], seed = 7100L)
    tibble::tibble(family_set = unname(family_names[d$family_set[1]]), algorithm = d$algorithm[1], AUC = unname(ci["auc"]),
                   AUC_low = unname(ci["low"]), AUC_high = unname(ci["high"]))
  }))
  sel_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(sel_rows)
  nested_freq <- sel_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(family_set, predictor) |>
    dplyr::summarise(outer_folds_selected = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(family_set = unname(family_names[family_set]), predictor = var_label(predictor)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(family_set, dplyr::desc(outer_folds_selected))
  nonnested <- internal_table[internal_table$model %in% c("GLM_F1", "GLM_F12", "GLM_F123", "ENS_F1", "ENS_F12", "ENS_F123"), ]
  nonnested$family_set <- unname(family_names[sub("^(GLM|ENS)_", "", nonnested$model)])
  nonnested$algorithm <- ifelse(grepl("^GLM", nonnested$model), "GLM", "Ensemble")
  for (i in which(nonnested$algorithm == "Ensemble")) {
    cvd <- res[[nonnested$model[i]]]$cv
    nonnested$AUC[i] <- fast_auc(cvd$obs, combine_components(cvd, c(rf = 1, xgb = 1, gbm = 1)))
  }
  nested_table <- dplyr::left_join(nested_table, nonnested[, c("family_set", "algorithm", "AUC")] |> dplyr::rename(AUC_selection_on_all_folds = AUC),
                                   by = c("family_set", "algorithm"))
  nested_table$selection_optimism <- nested_table$AUC_selection_on_all_folds - nested_table$AUC
}
```

```{r external-evaluation, results='hide'}
auc_pair <- function(p_pos, p_neg) {
  p_pos <- p_pos[is.finite(p_pos)]
  p_neg <- p_neg[is.finite(p_neg)]
  if (length(p_pos) < 5 || length(p_neg) < 50) return(NA_real_)
  fast_auc(c(rep(1L, length(p_pos)), rep(0L, length(p_neg))), c(p_pos, p_neg))
}

external_auc_ci <- function(p_ter, p_bg, ter_block, B = bootstrap_B, seed = 1L) {
  okt <- is.finite(p_ter)
  p_ter <- p_ter[okt]
  ter_block <- ter_block[okt]
  p_bg <- p_bg[is.finite(p_bg)]
  if (length(p_ter) < 5 || length(p_bg) < 50) return(c(auc = NA_real_, low = NA_real_, high = NA_real_))
  idx_by_block <- split(seq_along(p_ter), ter_block)
  set.seed(seed)
  boots <- replicate(B, {
    it <- unlist(idx_by_block[sample(names(idx_by_block), length(idx_by_block), replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE)
    ib <- sample.int(length(p_bg), length(p_bg), replace = TRUE)
    fast_auc(c(rep(1L, length(it)), rep(0L, length(ib))), c(p_ter[it], p_bg[ib]))
  })
  c(auc = auc_pair(p_ter, p_bg), low = stats::quantile(boots, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
    high = stats::quantile(boots, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
}

paired_external_delta <- function(pa_ter, pa_bg, pb_ter, pb_bg, ter_block, B = bootstrap_B, seed = 1L) {
  okt <- is.finite(pa_ter) & is.finite(pb_ter)
  okb <- is.finite(pa_bg) & is.finite(pb_bg)
  pa_ter <- pa_ter[okt]
  pb_ter <- pb_ter[okt]
  ter_block <- ter_block[okt]
  pa_bg <- pa_bg[okb]
  pb_bg <- pb_bg[okb]
  if (length(pa_ter) < 5 || length(pa_bg) < 50) return(c(delta = NA_real_, low = NA_real_, high = NA_real_))
  idx_by_block <- split(seq_along(pa_ter), ter_block)
  set.seed(seed)
  boots <- replicate(B, {
    it <- unlist(idx_by_block[sample(names(idx_by_block), length(idx_by_block), replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE)
    ib <- sample.int(length(pa_bg), length(pa_bg), replace = TRUE)
    y <- c(rep(1L, length(it)), rep(0L, length(ib)))
    fast_auc(y, c(pa_ter[it], pa_bg[ib])) - fast_auc(y, c(pb_ter[it], pb_bg[ib]))
  })
  c(delta = auc_pair(pa_ter, pa_bg) - auc_pair(pb_ter, pb_bg),
    low = stats::quantile(boots, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
    high = stats::quantile(boots, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
}

roc_points <- function(p_pos, p_neg, n_thr = 300L) {
  p_pos <- p_pos[is.finite(p_pos)]
  p_neg <- p_neg[is.finite(p_neg)]
  thr <- sort(unique(c(-Inf, stats::quantile(c(p_pos, p_neg), probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_thr), names = FALSE), Inf)),
              decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(fpr = vapply(thr, function(t) mean(p_neg >= t), numeric(1)), tpr = vapply(thr, function(t) mean(p_pos >= t), numeric(1)))
}
```

```{r area-of-applicability, results='hide'}
rf_weight_vector <- function(fm) {
  imp <- fm$rf$variable.importance[fm$predictors]
  imp[!is.finite(imp) | imp < 0] <- 0
  if (sum(imp) == 0) imp[] <- 1
  imp
}
aoa_runs <- lapply(family_models, function(m) {
  preds <- preds_of[[m]]
  w <- rf_weight_vector(final[[m]])
  tdi <- tryCatch(suppressMessages(CAST::trainDI(train = training_df[, preds, drop = FALSE], variables = preds,
                                                 weight = as.data.frame(t(w)), CVtest = fold_main)), error = function(e) NULL)
  di_of <- function(newdata) {
    out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(newdata))
    if (is.null(tdi) || nrow(newdata) == 0) return(out)
    X <- newdata[, preds, drop = FALSE]
    ok <- stats::complete.cases(X)
    if (!any(ok)) return(out)
    a <- tryCatch(suppressMessages(CAST::aoa(newdata = X[ok, , drop = FALSE], trainDI = tdi)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(a) && length(unlist(a$DI)) == sum(ok)) out[ok] <- as.numeric(unlist(a$DI))
    out
  }
  list(model = m, preds = preds, weights = w, tdi = tdi, threshold = if (!is.null(tdi)) as.numeric(tdi$threshold)[1] else NA_real_,
       di_of = di_of)
})

    data.frame(model = a$model, domain = "Buritaca 200 terraces", DI = a$di_of(ext_e$terr_df)),
    data.frame(model = a$model, domain = "Buritaca 200 landscape within 1 km", DI = a$di_of(ext_e$local[[main_key]]$df))

if (!is.null(aoa_runs$ENS_F123$tdi)) {
  mv <- as_vect(ext_e$map_buffer)
  st <- terra::mask(terra::crop(feature_windows[[s_ext]]$features[[predictors_f123]], mv, snap = "out"), mv)
  st <- terra::aggregate(st, fact = aoa_aggregate_fact, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
  vals <- terra::as.data.frame(st, cells = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (nrow(vals)) {
    di_map_main <- terra::setValues(terra::rast(st[[1]]), rep(NA_real_, terra::ncell(st)))
    di_map_main[vals$cell] <- aoa_runs$ENS_F123$di_of(vals)
    names(di_map_main) <- "DI"
  }
}
```

```{r prediction-surfaces, results='hide'}
train_cells_sf$oof_probability <- oof_mean_main
agg500 <- sf::st_make_grid(train_union, cellsize = 500, square = TRUE)
agg_sf <- sf::st_sf(id = seq_along(agg500), geometry = agg500)
agg_hits <- sf::st_intersects(agg_sf, train_pts)
agg_sf$n_cells <- lengths(agg_hits)
agg_sf$observed_share <- vapply(agg_hits, function(ii) if (length(ii)) mean(training_df$presence[ii]) else NA_real_, numeric(1))
agg_sf$predicted_mean <- vapply(agg_hits, function(ii) if (length(ii)) mean(oof_mean_main[ii], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_, numeric(1))
agg_sf <- agg_sf[agg_sf$n_cells >= 5, ]
agg_sf$residual <- agg_sf$observed_share - agg_sf$predicted_mean
agg_clip <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(agg_sf, sf::st_sf(geometry = train_union)))
oof_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  item = c("AUC of partition averaged out of fold probabilities", "Median out of fold probability, terrace cells",
           "Median out of fold probability, absence cells", "Aggregation cells of 500 m with at least 5 grid cells",
           "Correlation between observed share and mean prediction at 500 m", "RMSE of the 500 m residual"),
  value = c(fast_auc(training_df$presence, oof_mean_main), stats::median(oof_mean_main[training_df$presence == 1]),
            stats::median(oof_mean_main[training_df$presence == 0]), nrow(agg_sf),
            stats::cor(agg_sf$observed_share, agg_sf$predicted_mean), sqrt(mean(agg_sf$residual^2)))
)
```

```{r figure-setup, results='hide'}
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 8) {
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = pub_font) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 1, colour = "grey15"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.key.size = ggplot2::unit(3.5, "mm"),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.3),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25),
      plot.tag = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
    )
}

theme_map <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_pub(base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.2))
}

  }
}

add_scale_north <- function(p, scale_loc = "br", north_loc = "tl", width_hint = 0.25) {
  p +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = scale_loc, style = "bar", unit_category = "metric", width_hint = width_hint,
                                bar_cols = c("black", "white"), line_col = "black", text_col = "black", text_cex = 0.55,
                                height = ggplot2::unit(1.5, "mm"), pad_x = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm"), pad_y = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm"),
                                text_family = pub_font) +
    ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(location = north_loc, which_north = "true", height = ggplot2::unit(7.5, "mm"),
                                      width = ggplot2::unit(7.5, "mm"), pad_x = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm"), pad_y = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm"),
                                      style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(fill = c("white", "black"), line_col = "black",
                                                                                         text_col = "black", text_size = 5.5,
                                                                                         text_family = pub_font))
}

build_hillshade <- function(dem_in) {
  sl <- terra::terrain(dem_in, "slope", unit = "radians")
  as <- terra::terrain(dem_in, "aspect", unit = "radians")
  hs <- terra::shade(sl, as, angle = 40, direction = 315)
  names(hs) <- "hillshade"
  hs
}
```

```{r fig3-validation-design, fig.width=6.85, fig.height=6.8}
  ggplot2::labs(x = "AUC of the ensemble with all clean families", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub()
blocks_plot <- blocks
blocks_plot$fold <- as.integer(fold_maps[[main_seed]][as.character(blocks_plot$block_id)])
blocks_plot <- blocks_plot[!is.na(blocks_plot$fold), ]
blocks_plot$fold <- factor(blocks_plot$fold)
p3c <- rf_map(ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(blocks_plot, poly_sf)), ggplot2::aes(fill = fold), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = okabe_ito[c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7)], name = "Fold", drop = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = poly_sf, fill = NA, colour = "grey10", linewidth = 0.35))
catch_poly <- NULL
if (!is.null(catchment_folds) && !is.na(catchment_threshold_used)) {
  sb <- hydro$subbasins[[as.character(catchment_threshold_used)]]
  sb_w <- terra::mask(terra::crop(sb, as_vect(train_union), snap = "out"), as_vect(train_union))
  catch_poly <- sf::st_as_sf(terra::as.polygons(sb_w))
  names(catch_poly)[1] <- "unit"
  unit_fold <- tapply(catchment_folds, catch_vec, function(x) x[1])
  catch_poly$fold <- factor(unname(unit_fold[as.character(catch_poly$unit)]), levels = levels(blocks_plot$fold))
  catch_poly <- catch_poly[!is.na(catch_poly$fold), ]
}
bottom_row <- if (!is.null(catch_poly) && nrow(catch_poly) > 0) {
  p3d <- rf_map(ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = catch_poly, ggplot2::aes(fill = fold), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = okabe_ito[c(1, 2, 3, 5, 7)], name = "Fold", drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = poly_sf, fill = NA, colour = "grey10", linewidth = 0.35))
  (p3c + p3d) + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") & ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  p3c
}
fig3 <- (p3a + p3b) / bottom_row + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.3)) + patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
print(fig3)
fig_caption("Fig. 3", sprintf("Internal validation design in Río Frío. (a) Correlogram of the residuals of a preliminary GLM and of the raw response, with the selected block size of %s m as a dashed line. (b) AUC of the ensemble with all clean families under random folds, spatial blocks without and with a buffer of %d m around the held out cells, and catchment units with the same buffer, with bootstrap intervals; labels give the median distance from held out cells to the nearest retained training cell. (c) Spatial blocks and their assignment to five folds in the main partition. (d) Hydrological sub-basins used as units of the catchment cross validation and their assignment to five folds.",
                              format(spatial_block_size_m, big.mark = ","), as.integer(cv_buffer_m)))
fig_summary(cv_design_table, "Fig. 3", "design choices")
fig_summary(hydro_context_table, "Fig. 3", "hydrological context and edge contamination")
fig_summary(cg_plot |> dplyr::select(series, distance_m, correlation, pairs), "Fig. 3", "panel a", digits = 4)
fig_summary(cv_compare_table, "Fig. 3", "panel b")
fig_summary(retention_summary, "Fig. 3", "training data retained", digits = 1)
fig_summary(fold_table[fold_table$seed == main_seed, ], "Fig. 3", "panel c")
if (!is.null(catchment_folds)) {
  catch_folds_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(catchment_folds)), function(k) {
    tibble::tibble(fold = k, units = length(unique(catch_vec[catchment_folds == k])), cells = sum(catchment_folds == k),
                   presence = sum(training_df$presence[catchment_folds == k] == 1), absence = sum(training_df$presence[catchment_folds == k] == 0))
  }))
  fig_summary(catch_folds_table, "Fig. 3", "panel d")
}
```

```{r fig5-internal, fig.width=6.85, fig.height=6.2}
fig_models <- intersect(c("GLM_SLOPE", "GLM_JAA", "GLM_F1", "GLM_F123", "ENS_F1", "ENS_F123", "ENS_F123_ELEV", "ENS_F123_LC", "ENS_LEGACY"), internal_table$model)
lad <- internal_table[internal_table$model %in% fig_models, ]
nested_key <- c("Local morphology|Ensemble" = "ENS_F1", "Local morphology|GLM" = "GLM_F1",
                "All clean families|Ensemble" = "ENS_F123", "All clean families|GLM" = "GLM_F123")
nested_long <- if (nrow(nested_table)) {
  nt <- nested_table
  nt$model <- unname(nested_key[paste(nt$family_set, nt$algorithm, sep = "|")])
  nt <- nt[!is.na(nt$model) & nt$model %in% fig_models, ]
  data.frame(model = nt$model, design = "Spatial blocks, nested selection", AUC = nt$AUC, low = nt$AUC_low, high = nt$AUC_high)
} else {
  NULL
}
lad_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  nested_long,
  data.frame(model = lad$model, design = "Spatial blocks", AUC = lad$AUC, low = lad$AUC_low, high = lad$AUC_high),
  data.frame(model = lad$model, design = "Catchment units", AUC = lad$AUC_catchment, low = lad$AUC_catchment_low, high = lad$AUC_catchment_high)
)
lad_long <- lad_long[is.finite(lad_long$AUC), ]
lad_long$design <- factor(lad_long$design, levels = c("Spatial blocks, nested selection", "Spatial blocks", "Catchment units"))

p4a <- ggplot2::ggplot(lad_long, ggplot2::aes(x = AUC, y = label, colour = design, shape = design)) +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(ggplot2::aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.65), size = 0.22, linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("Spatial blocks, nested selection" = "#7B3294", "Spatial blocks" = "#1F3B57", "Catchment units" = "#E08214"), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("Spatial blocks, nested selection" = 15, "Spatial blocks" = 16, "Catchment units" = 17), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Cross validated AUC in Río Frío", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
key_contrasts <- c("Ensemble against GLM, local morphology", "Ensemble against GLM, all clean families", "Basin position added, ensemble",
                   "Basin position added, GLM", "Absolute elevation added", "Contemporary land cover added",
                   "V1 legacy predictors against all clean families", "All clean families ensemble against the JAA aligned GLM")
dplot <- contrast_table[contrast_table$contrast %in% key_contrasts, ]
dplot$contrast <- factor(dplot$contrast, levels = rev(intersect(key_contrasts, dplot$contrast)))
p4b <- ggplot2::ggplot(dplot, ggplot2::aes(x = delta_auc, y = contrast, colour = outcome, shape = outcome)) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(ggplot2::aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), size = 0.22, linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("Improves" = "#C0573D", "Degrades" = "#3B6EA5", "No detectable difference" = "grey45"), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("Improves" = 16, "Degrades" = 15, "No detectable difference" = 1), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Difference in AUC under spatial blocks", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig4 <- p4a / p4b + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.15, 1)) + patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
print(fig4)
fig_caption("Fig. 5", "Internal performance in Río Frío. (a) AUC under spatial blocks with the predictor selection repeated inside every outer fold, under spatial blocks with the selection made once on all folds, and under catchment units, with bootstrap intervals; the GLM with slope alone is the internal reference. Models without data driven selection have no nested estimate. (b) Paired differences in AUC under spatial blocks with block bootstrap intervals. Local morphology and hillslope hydrology is omitted because the selection added no hillslope predictor, so it equals local morphology.")
fig_summary(lad_long |> dplyr::transmute(model = as.character(label), design = as.character(design), AUC, low, high), "Fig. 5", "panel a")
fig_summary(dplot |> dplyr::select(contrast, delta_auc, ci_low, ci_high, partitions, partition_mean, partition_sd, outcome), "Fig. 5", "panel b", digits = 4)
fig_summary(selection_table, "Fig. 5", "predictor selection")
transfer_class <- function(v) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    v == "elevation" ~ "Absolute datum",
    v %in% c("dist_channel", "dist_mainchannel") ~ "Euclidean distance",
    v %in% c("dist_channel_sd", "dist_mainchannel_sd") ~ "Window SD of a distance field",
    v == "elevation_sd" ~ "Gradient proxy of elevation",
    v %in% lc_feature_names ~ "Contemporary land cover",
    TRUE ~ "Relative terrain"
  )
}
inv_vars <- unique(c(legacy_candidates, clean_candidates, setdiff(predictors_f123_lc, predictors_f123)))
sets_in <- function(sets) {
  vapply(inv_vars, function(v) {
    hit <- names(sets)[vapply(sets, function(z) v %in% z, logical(1))]
    if (length(hit)) paste(hit, collapse = ", ") else ""
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
predictor_inventory <- data.frame(
  Predictor = var_label(inv_vars), Family = predictor_family(inv_vars), `Spatial support` = spatial_support(inv_vars),
  Statistic = ifelse(grepl("_sd$", inv_vars), "Window SD", "Window mean"), `Reference class` = transfer_class(inv_vars),
  `V1 legacy` = ifelse(inv_vars %in% predictors_legacy, "yes", ""),
  `Retained after VIF` = sets_in(list(L = family_vif$F1, LH = family_vif$F12, A = family_vif$F123)),
  Selected = sets_in(list(L = predictors_f1, A = predictors_f123)), check.names = FALSE
)
predictor_inventory <- predictor_inventory[order(match(predictor_inventory$Family, c("Local morphology", "Hillslope hydrology", "Basin position",
                                                                                     "Absolute elevation", "Euclidean channel distance",
                                                                                     "Contemporary land cover")),
                                                 predictor_inventory$Statistic, predictor_inventory$Predictor), ]
fig_summary(predictor_inventory, "Fig. 5", "predictor inventory, L local morphology, LH local morphology and hillslope hydrology, A all clean families")
fig_summary(internal_table[internal_table$model %in% fig_models, ] |>
              dplyr::transmute(model = label, AUC_partition_mean, AUC_partition_sd, Brier),
            "Fig. 5", "partition statistics and Brier score")
fig_summary(contrast_table[!contrast_table$contrast %in% table3_contrasts & !grepl("hillslope", contrast_table$contrast, ignore.case = TRUE), ] |>
              dplyr::select(contrast, type, delta_auc, ci_low, ci_high, outcome),
            "Fig. 5", "contrasts not shown in Table 3", digits = 4)
if (nrow(nested_table)) fig_summary(nested_table, "Fig. 5", "nested selection and its optimism")
if (nrow(nested_freq)) fig_summary(nested_freq, "Fig. 5", "outer folds in which each predictor was selected")
```

```{r fig11-potential-maps, fig.width=6.85, fig.height=3.9}
  attr11 <- sf::st_drop_geometry(st11)

  per11 <- txt11[vapply(txt11, function(v) any(grepl("tairona", attr11[[v]], ignore.case = TRUE)), logical(1))]
  if (length(per11)) {
    st11 <- st11[grepl("tairona", attr11[[per11[1]]], ignore.case = TRUE), ]
    rf_point_source <- paste0("Tairona structures, period column ", per11[1])
  } else {
    rf_point_source <- "All structures, no period column found"
  }
  if (nrow(st11) > 0) rf_terr11 <- st11 else rf_point_source <- "Presence cell centroids"
}
```

```{r table1}
  data.frame(Set = "V1 legacy predictors", Role = "Reference", `Spatial support and reference` = "Mixed, with absolute elevation and Euclidean distances",
             Candidates = as.character(length(legacy_candidates)), `After VIF` = as.character(length(predictors_legacy)), Selected = "no selection",
             `Selected predictors` = sprintf("%d predictors retained after VIF", length(predictors_legacy)), check.names = FALSE),
  data.frame(Set = "Five JAA predictors", Role = "Reference", `Spatial support and reference` = "Published model, fixed set",
             Candidates = as.character(length(jaa_predictors)), `After VIF` = "not screened", Selected = "fixed",
             `Selected predictors` = names_or_none(jaa_predictors), check.names = FALSE)
)
manuscript_table(table1, paste("Predictor sets with their role, spatial support and reference, the number of candidates, the number retained after collinearity screening with a VIF below 10 inside each nested set, and the number kept by spatial forward selection with pruning. Families were defined by how each predictor is computed, before any external evaluation. Hillslope and basin position candidates were screened together with the predictors already retained in the previous set.",
                               if (!length(setdiff(predictors_f12, predictors_f1))) "The selection added no hillslope predictor." else ""),
                 key = "Table 1", col_spec = paste0(rr_col("3.4cm"), rr_col("2.4cm"), rr_col("5.6cm"), "rr", rr_col("2.8cm"), rr_col("11.5cm")))
```

```{r table2}
nested_cell <- function(models) {
  key <- c(ENS_F1 = "Local morphology|Ensemble", GLM_F1 = "Local morphology|GLM", ENS_F123 = "All clean families|Ensemble", GLM_F123 = "All clean families|GLM")
  vapply(models, function(m) {
    if (m %in% c("GLM_JAA", "ENS_LEGACY", "GLM_SLOPE")) return("no selection")
    if (!m %in% names(key) || !nrow(nested_table)) return("not computed")
    r <- nested_table[paste(nested_table$family_set, nested_table$algorithm, sep = "|") == key[[m]], ]
    if (!nrow(r)) return("not computed")
    fmt_ci(r$AUC[1], r$AUC_low[1], r$AUC_high[1])
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
ladder_models <- intersect(c("GLM_SLOPE", "GLM_JAA", "GLM_F1", "GLM_F123", "ENS_F1", "ENS_F123", "ENS_F123_ELEV", "ENS_F123_LC", "ENS_LEGACY"), internal_table$model)
t2 <- internal_table[match(ladder_models, internal_table$model), ]
table2 <- data.frame(
  Model = t2$label, Predictors = t2$n_predictors,
  `AUC spatial blocks [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(t2$AUC, t2$AUC_low, t2$AUC_high),
  `AUC nested selection [95% CI]` = nested_cell(t2$model),
  `AUC catchment units [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(t2$AUC_catchment, t2$AUC_catchment_low, t2$AUC_catchment_high),
  `PR AUC` = t2$PRAUC, `Calibration slope` = t2$calibration_slope, check.names = FALSE
)
manuscript_table(table2, paste(sprintf("Internal performance in Río Frío under %d fold cross validation with %s m spatial blocks, with the predictor selection repeated inside every outer fold, and with hydrological catchment units. Intervals come from bootstraps of blocks or catchment units. Models without data driven selection have no nested estimate. The GLM with slope alone is an internal reference added after the pre-specified criteria were first applied.",
                                       spatial_cv_k, format(spatial_block_size_m, big.mark = ",")),
                               if (setequal(predictors_f12, predictors_f1)) "The local morphology and hillslope set is omitted because it equals the local morphology set." else ""),
                 key = "Table 2")
```

```{r table3}
ct3 <- contrast_table[match(intersect(table3_contrasts, contrast_table$contrast), contrast_table$contrast), ]
table3 <- data.frame(
  Contrast = ct3$contrast, Type = ct3$type,
  `Difference in AUC [95% CI]` = sprintf("%+.4f [%+.4f, %+.4f]", ct3$delta_auc, ct3$ci_low, ct3$ci_high),
  `Mean over partitions` = ifelse(ct3$partitions > 1,
                                  sprintf("%+.4f (SD %.4f, n = %d)", ct3$partition_mean, ct3$partition_sd, as.integer(ct3$partitions)),
                                  "main partition only"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
manuscript_table(table3, "Pre-specified paired contrasts of cross validated AUC under spatial blocks. Each difference is the second model minus the reference on the same held out cells, with block bootstrap intervals. The visibility contrast describes an infill scenario because observers in neighbouring training blocks remain visible, and the leakage component is the difference between global and fold wise visibility, reported as a diagnostic.",
                 key = "Table 3")
```

```{r table4}
t4 <- ext_table[match(table4_models, ext_table$model), ]
pd4 <- paired_slope_table[paired_slope_table$radius_m == main_local_radius_m, ]
pd4 <- pd4[match(t4$model, pd4$model), ]
table4 <- data.frame(
  Model = unname(model_short[t4$model]),
  `AUC 1 km [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(t4$AUC_local_1000, t4$AUC_local_1000_low, t4$AUC_local_1000_high),
  `AUC 0.5 and 2 km` = sprintf("%.3f, %.3f", t4$AUC_local_500, t4$AUC_local_2000),
  Boyce = round(t4$Boyce_1000, 3),
  `Above Río Frío q85 (%)` = round(t4$pct_above_rio_frio_q85, 1),
  `Logit shift q85` = round(t4$logit_shift_q85, 3),
  `Difference from slope, 1 km [95% CI]` = ifelse(is.finite(pd4$delta_auc_vs_slope),
                                                 sprintf("%+.3f [%+.3f, %+.3f]", pd4$delta_auc_vs_slope, pd4$ci_low, pd4$ci_high),
                                                 "not evaluable"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
table4 <- rbind(table4, data.frame(
  Model = paste("Baseline,", tolower(baseline_row$label), "alone"),
  `AUC 1 km [95% CI]` = fmt_ci(baseline_row$AUC_local_1000, baseline_row$low, baseline_row$high),
  `AUC 0.5 and 2 km` = sprintf("%.3f, %.3f", baseline_row$AUC_local_500, baseline_row$AUC_local_2000),
  Boyce = NA, `Above Río Frío q85 (%)` = NA, `Logit shift q85` = NA, `Difference from slope, 1 km [95% CI]` = "reference",
  check.names = FALSE
))
lc_ext_cover <- lc_coverage(ext_data[[external_site]]$terr_df)
lc_note <- if (is.finite(lc_ext_cover) && lc_ext_cover == 0) {
  "The land cover model is not evaluated at Buritaca 200 because its Sentinel 2 and canopy height inputs do not extend to that site."
} else {
  sprintf("The land cover model is not evaluated at Buritaca 200, where its Sentinel 2 and canopy height inputs cover %.1f percent of the terraces.",
          100 * lc_ext_cover)
}
manuscript_table(table4, paste("External evaluation at Buritaca 200 of every pre-specified model. Local discrimination compares terraces with the landscape within 1 km, with the 0.5 and 2 km landscapes as sensitivity. The shift relative to Río Frío gives the share of terraces above the Río Frío 85th percentile and the logit shift, the local minus the Río Frío 85th percentile of predicted probability; without survey negatives at Buritaca 200 it measures a shift of the prediction distribution, not calibration in the strict sense. The last column, added after the criteria were first applied, is the paired difference in AUC from slope alone on the same resampled terraces and landscape points within 1 km.", lc_note),
                 key = "Table 4", header_above = c(" " = 1, "Local discrimination" = 3, "Shift relative to Río Frío" = 2, "Post hoc comparison" = 1))
```
